.input-sec {
    position: relative;
    height: 48px;
    display: flex;
}

    display:flex;

}

.input-sec label {
    position: absolute;
    color: #787070;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-family: 'Wells Fargo Sans';
    line-height: 20px;
    top: 10px;
}

.input-sec label.animated{
    transform: translate(4px, 4px);
    transform-origin: top left;
    color: #3B3331;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-family: 'Wells Fargo Sans';
    font-weight: bold;
    line-height: 1;
    top: 0;
}

.input-sec label.animated + input {
    color: #3B3331;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-family: 'Wells Fargo Sans';
    line-height: 20px;
    padding-top: 13px;
    padding-left: 4px;
}

.input-sec input {
    border: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #3B3331;
    outline: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 211px;

    margin-right: 16px;
}


#body section[data-id=content] input[type=text] {
    margin-top: 0;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #787070;

}

#body section[data-id=content] input[type=password], #body section[data-id=content] input[type=text] {
    margin-right: 16px;
    border: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #3B3331;
    height: 48px;
    margin-top: 0;
    width: 200px;
    border-radius: 0;
}

.inputs-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    margin-top:24px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

#body section[data-id=content] .input-sec label.animated + input[type=password], #body section[data-id=content] .input-sec label.animated + input[type=text] {
    border-radius: 2px;
    box-shadow: 1px #9A89D9;
}

#body section[data-id=content] .input-sec input:focus {

}

#body label[for=saveUsernameCheckbox] {

}

@media (max-width: 475px) {

<script nonce="">
    const userNameEL = document.querySelector(".inputs-wrapper #j_username");
    const passwordEl = document.querySelector(".inputs-wrapper #j_password");
    function animateLabel(e) {
        e.target.previousElementSibling.classList.add('animated');
    }
    function removeAnimation(e) {
        if (!e.target.value.trim().length) {
            e.target.previousElementSibling.classList.remove('animated');
            e.target.value = "";
        }
    }
    userNameEL.addEventListener('focus', animateLabel);
    userNameEL.addEventListener('blur', removeAnimation);
    passwordEl.addEventListener('focus', animateLabel);
    passwordEl.addEventListener('blur', removeAnimation);

    if (userNameEL.value.trim().length) {
        userNameEL.previousElementSibling.classList.add('animated');
    } else {
        userNameEL.previousElementSibling.classList.remove('animated');
    }

<script nonce="">
    (function () {
        const navContainer = document.querySelector(".nav-links");
        const navLinks = navContainer.getElementsByClassName('nav-link');
        let accWidth = 0;
            
        for (let i = 0; i < navLinks.length; i++) {
            accWidth += navLinks[i].getBoundingClientRect().width;

            if (accWidth > navContainer.getBoundingClientRect().width) {
                const prevNav = navLinks[i - 1];
                const separator = prevNav.querySelector('.link-separator');
                separator.style.backgroundColor = "transparent";
                accWidth = navLinks[i].getBoundingClientRect().width;
            }
        }        
    }());

                            if (event.keyCode === 32) {
                                obj.events.saveUsernamePopup.onclick(document.querySelector('[data-id="saveUsernameArrow"]'));
                                document.querySelector('#imgSaveUsernameCheck').style.outline = 'inherit';
                            }
                        },
                    },
                    'username': {
                        'onkeyup': function(element){
                            document.querySelector('#saveUsernameCheckbox').checked = false;
                        }
                    },
                    'destination': {
                        'onfocus': function(element){
                            document.querySelector('.custom-select').style.outline = 'thin solid #7DADD9';
                        },
                        'onblur': function(element){
                            document.querySelector('.custom-select').style.outline = 'inherit';
                        }
                    },
                    'form' : {
                    	'onsubmit' : function(evt) {
                    		evt.preventDefault();
                    		disableSubmitsCollectUserPrefs(evt.target);
                    		evt.target.submit();
                    	}
                    }
                }
                
                if (document.querySelector("#Signon")) {
                	document.querySelector("#Signon").addEventListener('submit', obj.events.form.onsubmit);
                }

                if(document.querySelector('.alert')){
                    document.querySelector('.alert').focus();
                }

                return obj;
            })()

            var Search = (function(){
                var obj = {};

                obj.events = {
                    'button': {
                        'onclick': function(){
                            document.querySelector('#frmSearch').submit();
                        },
                        'onkeyup': function(event){
                            event = event || window.event;
                            if (event.keyCode === 32 || event.keyCode == 13) {
                            	document.querySelector('#frmSearch').submit();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                return obj;
            })()
        </script>
        <script nonce="">
            function updateCustomSelect(){
            	if (document.querySelector('.custom-select')) {
	                document.querySelector('.custom-select').style.outline = 'inherit';
	                var select = document.querySelector('select');
	                var span = document.querySelector('.custom-select > span > span');
	                while(span.firstChild){
	                    span.removeChild(span.firstChild);
	                }
	                span.appendChild(document.createTextNode(select.options[select.selectedIndex].text));
            	}
            }
            
            function enrollPrivacySecLinkHandler(evt) {
            	evt.preventDefault();
        		setCookie('INLANG', 'EN', 0, '/', '.wellsfargo.com', (window.location.protocol != 'https:' ? 0 : 1));
            }
            
            if (document.querySelector('#frmSearch img[role=button]')) {
            	document.querySelector('#frmSearch img[role=button]').addEventListener('click', function(evt) {
            		Search.events.button.onclick();
            	});
            	document.querySelector('#frmSearch img[role=button]').addEventListener('keyup', function(evt) {
            		Search.events.button.onkeyup();
            	});
            }
            
            if (document.querySelector('#backToPreviousPageLink')) {
            	document.querySelector('#backToPreviousPageLink').addEventListener('click', function(evt) {
            		evt.preventDefault();
            		window.history.go(-1);
            	});
            }
            
			if (document.querySelector('#saveUsernamePopup img[data-id=saveUsernameClose]')) {
				document.querySelector('#saveUsernamePopup img[data-id=saveUsernameClose]').addEventListener('click', function(evt) { 
					LoginForm.events.saveUsernamePopup.onclick(); 
				});
			}
			if (document.querySelector('#saveUsernamePopup img[data-id=saveUsernameClose]')) {
				document.querySelector('#saveUsernamePopup img[data-id=saveUsernameClose]').addEventListener('keyup', function(evt) { 
					LoginForm.events.saveUsernamePopup.onKeyUp(); 
				});
			}

            if(document.querySelector('#saveUsernameCheckbox')){
                document.querySelector('#saveUsernameCheckbox').addEventListener('focus', function(evt) { LoginForm.events.saveUsername.onfocus(evt.target); });
                document.querySelector('#saveUsernameCheckbox').addEventListener('blur', function(evt) { LoginForm.events.saveUsername.onblur(evt.target); });
                document.querySelector('#saveUsernameCheckbox').addEventListener('change', function(evt) { LoginForm.events.saveUsername.onchange(evt.target); });
            }
			
            //removed enrollPrivacySecLinkHandler  listeners
			
            </script>
       	<script nonce="">
			window.onload = function(){
			    var time = 10 * 60 * 1000;
			    var flushCredsTimer;
			    var username = document.querySelector('#j_username');
			    var password = document.querySelector('#j_password');
			     
			    var startTimer = function() {
			        if (flushCredsTimer) {
			            window.clearInterval(flushCredsTimer);
			        }
			        flushCredsTimer = window.setInterval(flushCreds, time);
			    };
			
			    var clearTimer = function() {
			        if (flushCredsTimer) {
			            window.clearInterval(flushCredsTimer);
			        }
			        
			        flushCredsTimer = null;
			        startTimer();
			    };
			                 
			    var flushCreds = function() {
			        document.querySelector('#j_password').value = '';
			        
	                    document.querySelector('[data-id="saveUsernamePopup"]').style.display = 'none';
	                    document.querySelector('#j_username').value = '';
	                    document.querySelector('#imgSaveUsernameCheck').setAttribute('src', 'data:image/png;base64,');
	                    document.querySelector('#imgSaveUsernameCheck').setAttribute('checked', 'false');
	                    document.querySelector('#saveUsernameCheckbox').checked = false;
			    	
			    };
			    
			    username.addEventListener('keyup', clearTimer);
			    password.addEventListener('keyup', clearTimer);
			    startTimer();
			}
		</script>
